description: Add-on for Node.js repos (use together with renovate/default). Repos that set enabledManagers must include "nvm" for the .nvmrc part. The npm constraint is the npm major that comes with the Node.js major in .nvmrc (Node 24: npm 11), so that Renovate writes lock files with the same npm as CI and developers; change it together with the Node.js major.

packageRules.description: The Node.js version in .nvmrc (read by CI via setup-node's node-version-file) and the node base image in Dockerfiles move together. Also catches node-version inputs still hard-coded in workflows.
